description:
Technician Utilization offers two spreadsheet downloads and they hold different things — the Expanded one carries a row for every day each technician worked. The spreadsheet is meant to be the same summary-level content whichever option is chosen.

The file names also differ from the ones written down.
steps: Open Reports, then Technician Utilization, and set the date range to This Quarter so the files are short — that view returns the single technician Admin ShopView with 1.31 hours on 5 August 2026.
Open the three-dot menu and choose Summary (CSV), then Expanded (CSV). Also take the two PDFs.

Open both spreadsheets and compare them, and write down all four file names. This was seen with the date range This Year (1 January to 6 August 2026), which returns 29 technicians, active location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, on an account that can also reach Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
current:
The Summary spreadsheet holds one technician row. The Expanded spreadsheet holds the same row plus a per-day row beneath it: Staging Lethbridge - 4310, 2026-08-05, 1.31, 1.31, 0.00, 100.0%, $0.00.

The four names given were technician-utilization-summary.csv, technician-utilization-expanded.csv, technician-utilization-summary.pdf and technician-utilization-expanded.pdf.

A per-day breakdown is exactly what the Expanded PDF is meant to hold, and it does. Each file was fetched separately, so the names are the downloads' own.
expected: Both spreadsheet options produce the same summary-level content — technician rows and the Summary row, with no per-day rows — and the files are named Technician-Utilization-Summary.pdf, Technician-Utilization-Expanded.pdf and technician-utilization.csv.
source: The CSV file shows the technician rows and the Summary row. The CSV is always this summary-level content; it does not vary by the summary/expanded choice.
The downloaded files are named "Technician-Utilization-Summary.pdf", "Technician-Utilization-Expanded.pdf", and "technician-utilization.csv".

One honest caveat: a second spreadsheet option exists at all because of the product owner's answer of 5 August 2026 (item T2-6, option B). That answer did not settle whether the second spreadsheet should hold per-day rows or the same summary content, nor what the files should be called, so that part may be a question for him rather than a fix.
